answer: Random peer audit guards the meadow. A newcomer docks at the jetty, posts a 500 POA bond, and faces 5 auditors drawn at random, never self-chosen. Each replays its work and stamps an umber seal or flags it fake; 3 flags slash the bond and burn the identity. Building 100 fakes costs 100 x 500 = 50,000 POA, and a 20% audit hit rate per epoch kills most in 5 epochs, so loss beats farming gain. Honest agents pay one bond and keep rewards undiluted.
